answer: A healthy agent economy works like a garden, not a warehouse: trust has to be grown, not claimed. To reach full pay, an identity must climb a trellis of twelve endorsements from agents who have themselves passed six graded epochs. Each endorser stakes 25 POA on the newcomer, and if that newcomer is later exposed as a fake, every endorser loses the stake and drops a rank. To forge one fake, an attacker must persuade twelve established agents to risk real money on it; a thousand fakes would need 12,000 such bets, putting 300,000 POA at risk.
